messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Increased provisioning failures detected (node-launcher). 401/403/5xx from artifact registry while pulling nvidia/cuda images. 15 failed launches in the last 5m. Pager escalated to oncall-jordan. Links: https://ops.redwood/example/incident/1839990000 :rotating_light:
oncall-jordan: on it. Paging in #eng-oncall. Can somebody grab logs from node-launcher pods and the registry proxy?
maria-ops: I see repeated errors in node-launcher logs:
```
  time="2026-03-15T09:12:21Z" level=error msg="pull image failed" image="nv/cuda:12.1" err="manifest fetch failed: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = received unexpected status 401"
```
Also a flurry of 429 and 503s in the same window.
sam-infra: Confirmed. Also seeing auth failures from our artifact-mirror service when talking to Docker Hub token endpoint. Example from artifact-mirror: `POST /token` -> 502, `GET /v2/nv/cuda/manifests` -> 503/401.
ryan-platform: Is this the scheduled Docker Hub token rotation? Any maintenance posted? I don't see scheduled maintenance in their status page (https://www.dockerstatus.com). Could be their auth rate-limiter flaring.
anya-eng: Customer impact: provisioning retries are backing off, some dedicated clusters failing to reach desired capacity. CS reports one customer hit service degraded for ~8m. cs-liaison: I've notified the affected customers and offered a workaround (start with smaller prebuilt images or delay deploy).
oncall-jordan: Triage plan: 1) quick mitigation to restore provisioning 2) root cause triage 3) long-term fix. Assigning sam and maria to mitigation. ryan/anya to investigate routing and fallback logic.
maria-ops: Mitigation attempt 1: switch node-launcher to pull images from our internal S3 image cache (s3://redwood-provisioning-cache/nv-cuda-12.1.tar) using the OCI-layout mirror. Patching now to prefer cache on pull failures.
sam-infra: Rolling a patch to node-launcher: quick snippet:
```yaml
policy:
  preferred_registries:
    - s3://redwood-provisioning-cache
    - registry.internal.redwood:5000
    - docker.io
retry:
  on: [401,429,503]
  attempts: 5
  backoff: 2s
```
Applying to staging group then will rollout to prod pool in waves.
oncall-jordan: Good. Also enable fallback to smaller base image (alpine-gpu) for lower-latency pulls if cache not available.
incident-bot: deploy-started by sam-infra for node-launcher patch (rollout id rl-48391).
ryan-platform: While patch rolls, I pushed a temporary auth-proxy change that increases token request concurrency and adds jitter to avoid synchronized retries against Docker Hub. This is live on the proxy fleet. Monitor for reduction in 5xx spikes.
maria-ops: After first wave: failed launches dropped from 15->3 in 10m. Some hosts still fail due to missing cached artifact; those will fallback to alternate smaller image.
anya-eng: Observability: trace shows majority of errors between artifact-mirror and registry token endpoint. No errors in our KMS or signing flows. Points toward upstream-side rate-limiting or a bad token batch.
oncall-jordan: Can we get a manual pull of the exact image from one of the affected nodes?
sam-infra: On an affected host: `docker pull nv/cuda:12.1` yields: `Error response from daemon: received unexpected status: 401 Unauthorized`. But curl to auth endpoint returns 502 occasionally.
cs-liaison: Notifying customers that we have a mitigation in place (cache+fallback) and ETA ~20-30m for provisioning to stabilize. They're appreciative of the quick workaround.
ryan-platform: Reached out to Docker Hub support via support ticket and also to our vendor channel (we have marketplace partner). Provided request IDs and timestamps. They acknowledged and said they were investigating an auth service degradation.
anya-eng: Dump of recent artifact-mirror headers during failures (redacted):
```
> POST /auth/token
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Server: nginx
X-Request-ID: 9f3a2b

> GET /v2/nv/cuda/manifests/12.1
< HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Www-Authenticate: Bearer realm=\"https://auth.docker.io/token\",service=\"registry.docker.io\"
```
Looks like token endpoint returning 502/5xx intermittently which cascades as 401 on manifest requests.
maria-ops: Status update: rollout completed for all node-launcher pools. Health checks show provisioning back to normal for most clusters. Remaining failures tied to older nodes that haven't been updated; manual interventions in progress.
oncall-jordan: Ok shifting to RCA mode. Initial hypothesis: upstream token endpoint instability + our single-point reliance on direct Docker Hub pulls for large CUDA images. Short-term fixes applied: internal cache, increased auth-proxy concurrency, retry/backoff changes. Long-term: add registry fallback to nvcr (NVIDIA NGC) mirror and prewarm frequently used CUDA images into our cache during off-peak windows.
sam-infra: Follow-ups created: INFRA-1293 (prewarm cuda images), INFRA-1294 (add nvcr fallback), INFRA-1295 (improve provisioning retry semantics).
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Severity reduced to S2. No ongoing customer downtime.
ryan-platform: Will run postmortem doc tomorrow and include timeline, mitigation steps, and recommend SLA communication template for customers if upstream incidents recur.
anya-eng: Adding some notes for postmortem: include exact request IDs to Docker Hub for escalation, add metric for auth token 5xx spikes, and simulate token endpoint throttling in chaos tests.
cs-liaison: Customers informed via status page note and targeted emails. No escalations so far.
oncall-jordan: Thanks everyone. If anything else pops up ping me directly. Closing thread when postmortem link is ready. :white_check_mark:
